headline: Japan CPI Accelerates to Fuel Expectations for BOJ Interest Rate Hike
summary: Japan's consumer price growth accelerated amid higher energy costs, reduced fuel subsidies, and yen weakness, keeping the Bank of Japan on track for further rate increases above its current 1.25% policy rate.
why: The Bank of Japan's departure from ultra-loose monetary policy impacts global bond yields, carry trades, and currency valuations worldwide.

impacts.name: Japan Policy Rate
impacts.why: Higher inflation readings strengthen the case for the Bank of Japan to raise interest rates from 1.25%.
